result.summary: Found 1 major content issue where a raw localization key is displayed instead of a section title.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated, human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the 'home_feed.popular_title' key is properly mapped in the localization files and rendered with the appropriate localized text (e.g., 'Popular near you').
